PIT@NO.text: Steelers S DeShon Elliott is back from injured reserve for Sunday's game.

CIN@BAL.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson is ruled out with a high ankle sprain; Tyler Huntley starts.

CLE@TEN.text: Browns RB Quinshon Judkins is expected back from an ankle injury after missing Week 6.

IND@MIN.text: Colts CB Sauce Gardner (calf) and TE Tyler Warren (groin) are out against the Vikings.

MIA@NYJ.text: Jets RB Breece Hall is questionable and reportedly unlikely to play against Miami.

NYG@HOU.text: J.J. McCarthy starts at quarterback for the Giants, replacing Jameis Winston.

SF@ATL.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans (Achilles) and DE Nick Bosa (calf) are both out against Atlanta.

TB@CAR.text: Bucs QB Baker Mayfield is expected to start after missing three games with a dislocated thumb.

DEN@ARI.text: Cardinals rookie RB Jeremiyah Love is out with an ankle injury against the Broncos.

GB@DET.text: Josh Jacobs is back for the Packers after missing six games on the commissioner's exempt list.

LA@LV.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua is questionable for Sunday with a calf injury.

KC@SEA.text: Chiefs WR Rashee Rice is out for a second straight week with hamstring and knee injuries.

DAL@PHI.text: Tanner McKee starts at QB for the Eagles with Jalen Hurts sidelined by blood clots.

CAR@GB.text: Packers EDGE Micah Parsons and C Sean Rhyan won't be available Thursday against Carolina.

ARI@DAL.text: The Cardinals are 8-2 against the spread in their last 10 meetings with Dallas. America's Team, meet America's cover problem.

ATL@TB.text: The Bucs are 0-4 against the spread at home this season. Tampa: where covers go on vacation.

BAL@BUF.text: Ian Rapoport expects Lamar Jackson to return from his ankle injury against the Bills. Buffalo's bye week suddenly looks like homework time.

CLE@PIT.text: The 5-2 Browns beat Pittsburgh 27-24 on Oct. 1, with a point differential among the worst for a 5-2 team since 2000. Magic?

IND@JAX.text: Trevor Lawrence threw for 331 and 306 yards in London. The Colts, losers of three straight, hope he's still jet-lagged.

LV@NYJ.text: The Raiders have lost four straight, but Kirk Cousins keeps the job. Rookie Fernando Mendoza's turn is "not going to be this week."

MIN@DET.text: The Lions are 1-4-1 against the spread and 0-2-1 at home. The Vikings are 3-0 ATS on the road. Detroit, take notes.

TEN@CIN.text: The Bengals are 8-2 against the spread in the last 10 meetings with Tennessee. The Titans keep showing up anyway. Brave.

LAC@LA.text: The Chargers are 0-5-1 against the spread this season. Not one cover. Not one. The Rams have noticed.

KC@DEN.text: Denver is 7-3 against the spread in the last 10 meetings with Kansas City, yet the Chiefs are favored in Denver anyway. Bold.

NE@MIA.text: The Dolphins are 8-2 against the spread in the last 10 games against New England, and they're getting a full touchdown at home.

PHI@WAS.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts is on IR, and 2-5 Philly is 1-6 against the spread. Sunday night in D.C. just got interesting.

CHI@SEA.text: The Bears are an NFL-best 5-2 against the spread and covered all three games Caleb Williams started and finished. Seattle, consider yourself warned.
